correctness.rationale: The pair-mask criterion follows from exactly the selected endpoint being a self-witness and needing a second selected witness; resolving outside pairs is also required. Upward closure makes single-deletion testing a complete inclusion-minimality check. Two independent programs have traversed all 65536 subsets, agreeing on all cardinality coefficients, min five, 192 bases, minimal spectrum, and six-landmark fault-tolerant comparison. The Python implementation enumerated 96 automorphisms and the complete 192-state exchange graph, obtaining common degree five and distance profile (1,5,14,40,74,42,14,2). The strict/pure difference at two selected vertices was separately checked. No infinite statement is claimed.

value.rationale: A canonical symmetric cubic incidence graph offers a motivated sensor-layout test: requiring resolution plus a selected/unselected backup raises the minimum from the pure-case two to five, while full fault tolerance needs six. Exact classification gives three structurally distinct optimum geometric types, and a self-centered five-regular exchange network with a sharp seven-move mobility guarantee; these are natural structural and design-reconfiguration invariants, not arbitrary subsets or tiny parameter increments.
